name: uv
description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust (Astral). Drop-in replacement for pip, pip-tools, and virtualenv; runs CLI tools in ephemeral environments via uvx.

uv.description: Fast Python package and project manager - replaces pip, venv, and pip-tools with a single static binary
uv.usage:
uv venv # Create a virtual environment
uv pip install requests # Install into the active venv
uv run script.py # Run a script in the project environment
uv tool install ruff # Install a CLI tool onto PATH
uv sync # Sync project dependencies from the lockfile

uvx.description: Run a Python CLI tool in an ephemeral environment without installing it permanently (alias for 'uv tool run')
uvx.usage:
uvx ruff check . # Run ruff without installing it
uvx --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena serena start-mcp-server # Run an MCP server straight from git
uvx --python 3.12 black . # Pin the Python version for the run
uvx cowsay hello # Run a one-off tool
